content: AUTOSAR Shall Provide Guidance for Consistency of Profiles for Data Exchange Points Type: valid Description: The Standardization Template shall define consistency guidelines for profiles for data exchange points Rationale: Parts of a profile depend on each other. E.g. statements on default values are only required if the related attributes are relevant. Statements on completeness of meta-classes are only required if the meta-class is reachable from class AUTOSAR via containment references.
